correctness.rationale: The characteristic-two cubic expansion derives the exact tangent-cone criterion, and nondegeneracy makes its plane-cubic base smooth. Normalized Hermitian vectors satisfy v^[4]=(A^T)^(-1) A v, giving a complete 5-dimensional F4 solution space over F_{2^(2 ord(C))}. The program enumerates all 1023 nonzero vectors, quotients by the three allowed nonzero F4 scalars, finds exactly 165 isotropic geometric lines and decomposes their full Frobenius permutation for each 13-class representative. Independently, verify_orbits.c exhausts all 9,999,360 invertible binary matrices into thirteen disjoint congruence orbits, matching source weights. verify_small_fields.py tests the tangent-hyperplane cone condition directly over F2, F4, F8 for all classes; all predicted fixed-point counts agree. Explicit test outputs are recorded in VERIFICATION.md.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the previously unlisted ten-type full geometric Eckardt-Frobenius spectrum of the thirteen rational classes, which gives exact extension-degree counts and a finite étale locus zeta function for every coefficient-marked smooth binary Frobenius cubic. Cheng establishes the general geometric cone-point theorem; the prior published exact thirteen-class table provides rational point-line incidences but not Frobenius permutations on the 165 centers. Comparison was by mathematical implication and exact matrices, not title matching.
residual_risks: The cycle tables may have an unindexed equivalent in classical finite-unitary-group or semilinear-form arithmetic literature.
The exhaustive thirteen-class matrix list is already published and is an input, not an original result; novelty is only the full 165-center Frobenius splitting census.
No independent mathematical audit has been undertaken.

value.rationale: The 165 tangent-cone centers control the cone-based geometry of the Fano surface of a smooth 2-bic cubic threefold. The complete exact classification gives a previously unspecified rational descent invariant and all extension-field point counts of this finite geometric locus. In particular, degree-five first occurrence in one class and degree-24 complete splitting in two classes are motivated arithmetic phenomena not captured by the source rational point-line profiles. This is a natural complete splitting classification, not an arbitrary coefficient slice or small isolated table.
